Title: Chatbot
Description:
Drops a public-facing, AI-powered chat widget on a website's frontend. End users on the public site type a question; the package runs a semantic search over the site's Umbraco content (Umbraco.AI.Search), feeds the matched pages into an Umbraco.AI.Agent, and streams a grounded answer back with cited source pages and follow-up suggestions.

The official Umbraco.AI.* packages expose chat only inside the backoffice. There is no path for an anonymous site visitor to ask questions of the site's content. This community package fills that gap.

Key features:
- Public-facing widget (drop in one <script> tag)
- Grounded answers with cited source pages
- Suggested follow-up questions
- Streaming responses (SSE)
- Per-IP rate limiting and request size caps
- Per-instance configuration in the backoffice (welcome message, agent, fallback)

Requires Umbraco CMS 17.3+, Umbraco.AI 1.10+, Umbraco.AI.Agent 1.9+, and a populated Umbraco.AI.Search index.
